summary: R1.2 Process Ancestry + R4 PDF Export: 100% pass. Backend fast-gate pytest 807/807 (tests/rc5/ with -m 'not slow'). All 6 backend live-endpoint checks pass: ancestry by binary name (200, correct schema, node role/mitre/events populated, events[key].length == event_count), ancestry unknown process (404), no-auth (403), PDF (200 application/pdf, %PDF- magic, X-Nivxray-Report-Sha256 64-hex, X-Nivxray-Report-Schema r4.0, Content-Disposition attachment ending .report.pdf, byte-deterministic across 2 calls, empty case still returns valid PDF). Frontend: chevron row-ancestry-bin:cmd.exe navigates to /v2/ancestry, v2-process-ancestry renders with case_id/root/stats strip (ANCESTORS/DESCENDANTS/EVENTS 15), 1 ancestry-node card rendered (correct — shadow adapter emits single-root graph, expected per problem statement), clicking node opens ancestry-node-detail drawer with verdict/label/15 ancestry-event items, ancestry-detail-close closes drawer and returns to Legend, ancestry-back returns to /v2/trajectory. Report modal shows all 4 buttons; report-download-pdf triggers download of case_dfir_bumblebee_akira_2026.report.pdf. R1.1 regression: filter-chips, glyph-legend-trigger, case-selector-trigger, report-copy-json/md, report-download-md/json all present and enabled.

issues: Benign React console warning: shorthand vs non-shorthand borderColor/borderLeftColor conflict during rerender in the node card / drawer. Not user-visible but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Fix React shorthand-vs-non-shorthand borderColor warning in ProcessAncestry.jsx node/drawer styles.
critical_code_review_comments: All feature-flag guarding, auth, and determinism guarantees verified end-to-end. Live-test module test_r4_live.py correctly excluded from fast gate via pytestmark = pytest.mark.slow. No blocking issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest must be run with PYTHONPATH=/app/backend (env loaded via `set -a && source .env && set +a`) — without it, engine/v2 modules fail to import. The fast gate runs in ~4 minutes. Shadow adapter produces single-node ancestry graph (root only, no parents/descendants) for the seeded case — this is expected until R2.5 EDR telemetry lands.
